implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA (supabase/functions/api/index.ts, billingFulfilmentOf ~L3108-3130): reconciliation required a subscriber row whose providerTransactionIdentity equalled the journaled store_transaction_id AND whose purchase_date equalled the journaled purchasedAt (`matching.length !== 1 -> pending`).
